svg.text: Same automatic slider identity, derived from the 11.5–123.5 wall source and centered in the
64-unit live slot. Current cream, rust, green, teal, and charcoal registers continue through
Larger office glazing improves the ordinary-office read. Quieter lower panels and one mode
lens retain QuotaCo machinery without turning the doorway into a security checkpoint.
The horizontal slider is preserved. The vertical case exposes floor around a narrow top-oblique leaf barrier; it is not a rotated front elevation.
